values.note: 71 sites on two paved loops (Pinon, Juniper), 50 reservable; a dozen are walk-in tent sites. Forest Service: max RV 50 ft, and everything with wheels must fit on the spur (no overflow parking). recreation.gov rates the RV sites 24-45 ft, with 7 pull-throughs. Four group sites in the adjacent McPhee Group Area.

note: San Juan NF, on a mesa about 500 ft above McPhee Reservoir near Dolores, ~7,400 ft, in pinyon and juniper; the walk-in tent sites have scenic overlooks. The McPhee Marina boat ramp and fish-cleaning station are in the complex below; the Can Do Trail climbs 1/2 mile to the Ridge Point overlook. --Claude
